verdict.rationale: An API reference section exists in Hyperbrowser's own docs: a 'Fetches a web page' endpoint page lives under /docs/api-reference. However, nothing in the pack shows it is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no public spec at any candidate path. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive playground or try-it console, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
